name: number-input
title: Number input
description: A numeric field with decrease and increase buttons.
a11y: Native input type="number"; ArrowUp/ArrowDown change the value.
The step buttons are named "Decrease" and "Increase" and are skipped by Tab.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`). A surrounding Field sets this from its `error`.

usage: import {Field, NumberInput} from '@monoline/react';
